about.title: ABOUT

experiences.title: MBO-4 Software Developer
experiences.description: During my MBO-4 Software Development program, I built a strong technical foundation in front-end, PHP back-end, and game development with Unity. I also learned essential programming concepts such as MVC architecture and gained experience using version control with Git.

experiences.title: Software Development Intern
experiences.description: Worked on Unity game projects using C# and WordPress websites. Assisted in managing partner relationships and held client meetings to gather requirements. What stuck with me most from this internship is how much I enjoyed talking with clients and translating their needs into working software.

experiences.title: Junior Software Developer
experiences.description: Designed a website for the gaming brand AXiS Gameforce and developed a Unity-based GUI for a data entry application. Supervised a team of interns on WordPress projects and took on a larger role in project management. Also worked on an educational web game for children, in collaboration with the American company Phunics.

experiences.title: Associate Degree Software Development
experiences.description: Worked in a team environment on various software projects in Java and C#, within an agile learning setup. We developed, among other things, a CLI tool for patient management, a JavaFX public transport app for people with autism, a C# dashboard for a real client, and a flashcard game for learning programming terms. What I love about this program is the strong connection between students and teachers, leading to in-depth discussions not only about software development but also about UX and design.

experiences.title: Python Data Structures
experiences.description: A course focused on understanding and applying data structures in Python.

text: My interest in creating software started at a young age, experimenting with game development in Scratch and later building small projects in Unity. That curiosity quickly grew into a real passion for crafting digital experiences that are both functional and user-friendly.

What I enjoy most about software development is not just solving technical challenges, but also understanding the needs of the people who use the software. Clients have often told me they appreciate how I truly listen and understand their requirements, something I value greatly in my work.

I am currently looking for an internship as a software developer, in a team where I can apply my creativity and further develop my technical skills. Ideally, I want to contribute to innovative projects that solve problems where no solution currently exists.
